test_title: PYST 10: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 20 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question: How does the spread of the internet and expansion of e-commerce help people?

options.text: Online payments don't attract people at all.

solution:
The correct answer is '**Online payments are fast catching**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage states, "**With the spread of Internet and expansion of e-commerce, online payments are fast catching on among the middle class.**"
 
• This indicates that online payments are becoming increasingly popular and widely adopted.
 
• The context suggests that as more people gain access to the internet and engage in e-commerce, they are more likely to use online payment methods.

Therefore, the correct answer is ‘**Option 2**’.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Online payments don't attract people at all:**

 
 
• This is incorrect. The passage explicitly states that online payments are becoming more popular.
 
 
 
• **Online payments are expensive:**
 
 
• ​The passage does not discuss the expense of online payments. It focuses on the increasing adoption of online payments.
 
 
 
• **Online payments are slow catching:**
 
 
• ​This is the opposite of what the passage indicates. The passage clearly states that online payments are fast catching on.
